job.label: Lever Carbine — Masterwork
job.prompt:
Create the Masterwork-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG lever-action carbine inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes exact Standard geometry and registration: preserve the complete visible carbine outline, every part and opening, shallow muzzle-up-right diagonal, pose, camera, scale and margins. SECOND is the preceding grade: keep its surface additions except the specified current material changes. THIRD supplies Heavenprint ink and gouache brushwork only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Masterwork. Keep everything of the Fine grade. Inlay the engraved line with the item's accent colour (bright brass if it has no accent), so the side carries one continuous coloured stripe. The grip panels or stock are re-made in a finer material in exactly the same shapes (polished hardwood, ivory polymer or lacquer, in the item's own colours); the trigger, hammer, screws and pins are polished brass or bright steel; machining exact, every edge crisp. No wear.

Keep the existing walnut stock and fore-end shapes, original brass receiver/bands/buttplate, two straight tubes, large lever loop, trigger, sights and TWO visible muzzle slots. Inlay the preceding Fine upper-receiver engraved route with ONE narrow continuous bright polished brass stripe. Refinish the same walnut surfaces as fine figured polished walnut and polish existing fasteners; no wear, no new ornament or repair. Apply only those surface changes to actual parts shown. Do not add, remove, resize or move any part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink, broken directional strokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, frame, border, flash, smoke or external glow. Exterior painted illustration only, no technical diagram, internal mechanism, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
job.keep_line: the same short lever-action carbine on a shallow muzzle-up-right diagonal, slim walnut buttstock with dark brass-edged buttplate, large oval lever loop below the brass receiver, one curved trigger, long reddish walnut fore-end, straight barrel above a tubular magazine, brass fore-end bands, small iron sights and short slotted muzzle fitting. Preserve every tube length, loop opening, plate, rivet and screw, the walnut grain and original warm brass fittings. No new magazine or sights, no coloured accent.
